instruction: Open the raw image and save it in GIF format maintaining original color palette.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because the source file is a JPEG with 24-bit color (not RAW), and the task requires maintaining the 'original color palette' when converting to GIF (which only supports 256 colors). The instruction is inherently contradictory - you cannot maintain a full-color JPEG palette in an indexed-color GIF format. This makes evaluation impossible without arbitrary decisions about acceptable color reduction.
